text:
Maya: Heads up — seeing a ~15% delta between ingest-side priority credits and the invoice-preview for tenant_42. Routing shows many events marked 'burst' but preview doesn't count them. Anyone seen this?
Eric: Which time window? 24h or 1h?
Maya: 24h. Quick query I ran: `SELECT sum(credits) FROM metering WHERE tenant='tenant_42' AND tag='burst' AND ts > now()-24h;` -> 1200 credits. Billing preview shows 1020.
Leah: Could be late-arriving events or dedupe window. We had a small backlog on the priority queue overnight.
Alex-SRE: Also check the routing proxy — some proxies strip headers on fallback. `x-route-priority` sometimes gets lost when we hit the 429 fallback path.
Maya: I grepped edge logs and found this snippet: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-18T13:01:02Z","tenant":"tenant_42","route":"/v1/generate","x-route-priority":"burst","token_count":34}
```
Sam-PM: If proxies drop it, console dashboards will be out of sync. PM/UX asked for a "priority attribution" column in invoice preview — do we currently instrument both pre- and post-router attribution?
Eric: We have two marks: `ingest.tagging` and `billing.attribution`. Tagging is async and if the request is rerouted to a fallback pool, the header can be lost before tagging runs. We should consider sticky header propagation in the routing policy.
Leah: Also the preview sampler uses `request_count` instead of `token_count` for some legacy previews — that alone explains some of the delta.
billing-bot: alert: invoice-preview pipeline lag detected at 2026-03-18T13:05 UTC — backlog=2.1k events. Investigating.
Alex-SRE: Quick mitigation idea: run a dry-run backfill in ingest-transform that marks events as `priority=true` if we can match them from edge logs by trace_id for last 48h. I'll prepare a dry-run first.
Maya: Coordinate with billing before any backfill please. We need a clear rollback plan.
Sam-PM: UX suggestion: expose a console toggle "Include routing-fallback events in invoice preview" with tooltip explaining retrospective credits and potential delays.
Leah: Agree — show a "suspect_priority" badge in the preview rows so ops can filter.
Eric: Proposed action items: (1) instrument where header is dropped (routing proxy + fallback path) (2) add header propagation in fallback codepath (3) emit `suspect_priority` metric for sampler so dashboards can flag discrepancies (4) decide on backfill after dry-run.
Maya: I'll open the follow-up PR for header propagation + tests and a canary rollout plan. Tagging @Alex-SRE to run the dry-run once PR merges. Also need short console notice for affected tenants.
Alex-SRE: Dry-run started. Using a zero-delta transform and flagging records. Posting results in ~10m.
billing-bot: dry-run complete at 2026-03-18T13:22 UTC — flagged 1220 suspect events for tenant_42. No invoice changes applied.
Sam-PM: Great. Let's do a 15m sync after you post the full dry-run report. Need to decide on backfill vs delay-only approach. :calendar: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya: Thanks all — will share PR link and the canary rollout doc shortly.
ingest-bot: canary deploy started for `ingest-transform` v2.3.1-canary by Maya.
Alex-SRE: will follow up with logs and metrics after the canary.
Maya: filing follow-up ticket and console copy for affected tenants.
